behavior: The owner reopens a partly paid invoice from its page, and the pay page takes payments until the new close
acceptance: On the owner's page an invoice that closed partly paid and is reopenable offers Reopen beside New invoice for the rest; a confirm dialog says it reopens once, until the new close; after it the page shows the new close and partly paid, and History shows Reopened with the day

The pay page and the owner's page read closesAt for closed, payable and time left, so a reopened invoice shows its address and time left until 5 minutes before the new close; the address check still uses the terms' expiresAt
The canary reads closes_at as an eleventh input field and checks a reopened invoice until its new close; money-safety.md's format and query match
Text saying an invoice never reopens (landing, web comments, R-77, D-92) matches R-130; unit, lint, typecheck and e2e pass
